quiet.text: The apartment is dark. A neighbor in a bathrobe says the shouting stopped an hour ago. Nobody answers the door.

quiet2.text: A woman opens the door on the chain. She says it was the TV and the TV is off now. There's a fresh bruise on her cheek she doesn't mention.

options.text: Ask, quietly, whether she's safe to talk.

success.note: She talks. You take a domestic violence report and leave her a card.

failure.note: She closes the door. You leave a card in the jamb.

success.note: You clear the call. Your FTO says nothing for two blocks.

drunk.text: A man in an undershirt is in the courtyard, drunk, yelling at a window on the second floor. Neighbors are watching from the stairs.

options.text: Order him to sit on the curb.
Go hands-on and take him in for drunk in public.

success.note: He fights the cuffs a little. You win.

drunk_calm.text: He sits. He cries a little. His sister lives upstairs and she won't let him in.

options.text: Get the sister to take him in for the night.

success.note: She takes him. The courtyard goes quiet.

failure.note: She won't. You walk him to the corner and give him a warning.

options.text: Book him for drunk in public.

drunk_angry.text: He squares up and calls you every name he knows in two languages.

options.text: Give him a clear way out: walk away now and it's over.

argue.text: Two people shouting on a landing. The man keeps his right hand in his jacket pocket and won't take it out.

options.text: Separate them and keep your distance from him.

success.note: He pulls a knife out of the pocket.

argue_sep.text: Apart, she tells you he's been using again and he keeps a knife on him. He's watching you over his shoulder.

options.text: Pat him down: you have reasonable suspicion now.

success.note: A kitchen knife in his jacket. Brandishing, on her statement.

argue_hands.text: He takes his hand out slowly. Empty. The knife is still in the pocket and everybody knows it.

options.text: Take the knife, write a report, let him go.

success.note: You book the knife. He walks.

blood.text: This is not a disturbance. There's blood on the stairs and a man is bleeding in the courtyard. Somebody upstairs is still screaming.

options.text: Treat the victim while your partner covers.

success.note: You go in with your partner covering.
Backup is coming. The victim is still bleeding.
